page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a baseline frequency of 2.55 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not feature local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. The instance demonstrates high efficiency in parallelized workloads, showing strong results in software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, image processing, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory performance is split, showing strong read-only bandwidth for small cached blocks, but falling into the average tier for large uncached read and write operations. Large-scale database operations and small-model LLM inference also perform in the top tier.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the instance provides a highly capable environment for workloads requiring sustained multi-core throughput. It is well-suited for database hosting, software build pipelines, multi-threaded data processing, and static web serving where local storage is not a primary requirement.
